author: Karl Rock
description:
Inside Hyderabad's historic Pakka Qila, a fort built in the 18th century and later settled by migrants after Partition, I stumbled across another side of life inside its walls: a local shoe-making industry.

In small workshops, craftsmen were making traditional Peshawari chappals, including pairs branded as Gucci 😂 Gucci doesn't officially sell Peshawari chappals... yet. Maybe Pakistan is giving them ideas for the next collection?
title: Inside a Fake Gucci Factory in Pakistan
